insertion: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
description: The supraspinatus originates from the supraspinous fossa of the scapula. Its tendon passes laterally beneath the acromion and inserts onto the superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.
冈上肌起自肩胛骨冈上窝。其肌腱向外侧走行，从肩峰下方经过，止于肱骨大结节上小面。
action: It contributes to shoulder abduction and helps stabilize the humeral head in the glenoid cavity.
它参与肩关节外展，并帮助将肱骨头稳定在关节盂内。

insertion: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
description: The infraspinatus originates from the infraspinous fossa of the scapula. Its fibers converge laterally into a tendon that passes behind the glenohumeral joint and inserts onto the middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.
冈下肌起自肩胛骨冈下窝。肌纤维向外侧汇聚成肌腱，经盂肱关节后方走行，止于肱骨大结节中小面。
action: It externally rotates the humerus and contributes to dynamic stability of the glenohumeral joint.
它使肱骨外旋，并参与盂肱关节的动态稳定。

origin: Upper part of the lateral border of the scapula
insertion: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
description: The teres minor originates from the upper part of the lateral border of the scapula. It runs superolaterally along the inferior border of the infraspinatus and inserts onto the inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.
小圆肌起自肩胛骨外侧缘上部。它沿冈下肌下缘向上外侧走行，止于肱骨大结节下小面。
action: It assists external rotation of the humerus and helps stabilize the humeral head. Teres major is a separate muscle and is not part of the rotator cuff.
它协助肱骨外旋并帮助稳定肱骨头。大圆肌是另一块肌肉，不属于肩袖。

origin: Subscapular fossa on the anterior surface of the scapula
肩胛骨前面的肩胛下窝
description: The subscapularis originates from the subscapular fossa on the anterior surface of the scapula. It passes laterally in front of the glenohumeral joint and inserts onto the lesser tubercle of the humerus.
肩胛下肌起自肩胛骨前面的肩胛下窝。它经盂肱关节前方向外侧走行，止于肱骨小结节。
action: It internally rotates the humerus and contributes to anterior stability of the glenohumeral joint.
它使肱骨内旋，并参与盂肱关节前方的稳定。
